            // Implementation of isSafeAttribute
        }
        
        public String getValue() {
            return attribute.getValue();
        }
    }

    public static class Element {
        public void setAbsUrl(String url) {
            this.absUrl = url;
        }
        
        public String absUrl(AttributeKey key) {
            return absUrl;
        }

        private String absUrl;

        private String getAbsUrl() {
            return absUrl;
        }

            this.absUrl = absUrl;
        }
    }
}
